name: Certification of JUMO dTRANS T06 according to DIN EN 61508
description: Component-level FMEDA for the JUMO dTRANS T06, Type 707071, for certification according to DIN EN 61508 SIL 2.

safety_context.safety_function_name: NE43 Failure Output and Safe Relay Shutdown
safety_context.safety_function_description: The JUMO dTRANS T06 acquires temperature and process signals from resistance thermometers, thermocouples, resistance transmitters, current inputs and voltage inputs. In the event of a relevant transmitter or sensor fault, the analog output provides failure information according to NAMUR NE43. If the relay safety function is used, the relay changes to the de-energized state according to the de-energized-to-trip principle.
safety_context.safe_state: The analog output provides failure information A according to NAMUR NE43, with an output current of less than or equal to 3.6 mA or greater than or equal to 21.0 mA. If the relay safety function is used, the relay is de-energized and the quiescent-current circuit is switched off.
safety_context.dangerous_state:
The analog output does not provide failure information A according to NAMUR NE43, or the relay does not de-energize when the safety function is demanded. A dangerous undetected failure exists when the output current does not indicate the fault and the required relay shutdown is not performed.
``
safety_context.safety_boundary: The safety boundary includes the safety-related sensor input and signal-conditioning path, ADC and safety CPU, safety-related analog output, internal diagnostic CPU, relevant 230 V or 24 V power-supply circuitry, the optional relay or RS485 interface when installed, PCB-related elements, adapter PCB and display or keyboard elements where their failures can influence the safety function. External sensors are included only when a selected RTD or DTE sensor failure model forms part of the evaluated complete-device configuration.
safety_context.no_part_failure_definition:
Failure of a component that does not contribute to the implementation of the safety function. The failure of a non-participating component is not considered in the safety-function failure-rate or SFF calculation.

`
safety_context.no_effect_failure_definition: Failure of a component that contributes to the implementation of the safety function, but whose evaluated failure mode has no direct effect on the safety function. The failure is not considered in the safety-function failure-rate or SFF calculation.
safety_context.notes: The FMEDA applies to the safety-relevant input stages RTD2, RTD3, RTD4, DTE and 4–20 mA. Device-only and device-plus-sensor configurations are evaluated separately. If NAMUR NE43 failure information A is present, a detection value of 99% is used according to the workbook assumptions. If the relay is de-energized in the fault condition, a detection value of 99% is used. For specified EMC effects, a 50% safe/unsafe influence may be used. Proof Test A represents manufacturer recalibration, Proof Test B represents simulation of input and output signals, and Proof Test C represents simulation of the output signal.

units.name: SFTY-ADC-CPU
units.description: Safety-related analog input and CPU path, including signal conditioning, ADC, reference circuits, safety controller and associated components used for safety-related measurement processing.

components.name: CKPe
components.function: Buffer and decoupling capacitor in the safety-related analog-input and ADC supply path

failure_mode_assignments.notes: The capacitor short circuit can make the safety-related measurement invalid or unavailable. ADC plausibility monitoring detects the fault and initiates the defined NAMUR NE43 fault reaction.
For this application calculation test, the open-circuit failure is classified as safe. The final classification must be confirmed against the actual circuit and workbook row.

A component-value change may cause an incorrect but electrically plausible measurement. For this software test, partial monitoring is assumed to detect 60% of the dangerous failure rate. This value requires circuit-specific evidence before engineering use.

deviations.name: Invalid safety-related measurement
deviations.description: The failure causes an invalid, unavailable or incorrect measurement signal in the safety-related analog-input and ADC path.
deviations.effect: The safety controller may receive an invalid process value.

deviations.name: Reduced input filtering and EMC performance
deviations.description: The failure reduces filtering or decoupling in the safety-related analog-input path.
deviations.failure_mode: Reduced input filtering and EMC performance

deviations.name: Changed input filtering behaviour
deviations.description: A component-value change modifies the filtering or stabilization characteristics of the analog-input path.

mitigations.name: NAMUR NE43 failure-state output
mitigations.description: When a relevant fault is detected, the analog output is driven to failure information A according to NAMUR NE43, at less than or equal to 3.6 mA or greater than or equal to 21.0 mA.

mitigations.name: Input and ADC plausibility monitoring
mitigations.description: The device monitors the safety-related input and ADC result for invalid, unavailable or implausible values and initiates the defined fault response.

mitigations.name: Component tolerance and filtering verification
mitigations.description: Component selection, tolerance analysis, circuit verification and EMC testing reduce the risk of an unacceptable measurement deviation.

diagnostic_measures.notes: Detects unavailable, invalid or implausible safety-related measurement values.
Detects selected measurement deviations while some electrically plausible deviations may remain undetected.
